text: Educational Objective The program pursues to train senior managerial professionals equipped with sound business management knowledge and capabilities as well as an international vision and pioneering spirit. Curricula 16 units in total: Accounting for Managers, Marketing, Human Resource Management, Business Finance, International Trade Law, Management Communication, Organizational Behavior, Economics for Managers, Statistical Analysis & Decision Making, Management Ethics, International Business, Strategic Management, Production and Operations Management, Chinse Language, China Brief and Chinese Economy and Cultural. Internship Human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise. Degree Awarded Master of Business Administration Career Graduates can engage in the field of human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise.
